# SoapUI .vmoptions file
## What is the .vmoptions file?
The `.vmoptions` file is a reference file that contains all the JVM options that are configured in the SoapUI executable.
## Location
The file is located in: ``` bin/SoapUI-${project.version}.vmoptions ```
## Current status
**IMPORTANT**: The JVM options are currently compiled directly into the `.exe` executable due to the installed version of Launch4j. The `.vmoptions` file serves as:
1. **Reference**: Shows all options that are active in the executable 2. **Template**: Base for future customizations 3. **Documentation**: Complete list of JVM configurations
## Options included in the executable
### Memory - `-Xms128m` - Initial memory - `-Xmx1024m` - Maximum memory - `-XX:MinHeapFreeRatio=20` - Minimum heap free ratio - `-XX:MaxHeapFreeRatio=40` - Maximum heap free ratio
### SoapUI settings - `-Dsoapui.home=..` - SoapUI home directory - `-Dsoapui.properties=soapui.properties` - Properties file - `-Dsoapui.ext.libraries=../bin/ext` - External libraries - `-Dsoapui.ext.listeners=../bin/listeners` - Listeners - `-Dsoapui.ext.actions=../bin/actions` - Actions - `-Djava.library.path=../bin` - Native libraries
### Java 17 settings - Multiple `--add-opens` options for module compatibility
### Security - `-Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true` - CVE-2021-44228 protection
## How to customize (future versions)
To use the .vmoptions file with newer versions of Launch4j:
1. **Update Launch4j** to version 3.12+ that supports vmOptionsFile 2. **Edit build.xml** and add `<vmOptionsFile>` in the configuration 3. **Recompile** the executable
## Current customization
To customize the JVM options currently, edit the `build.xml` file in the `<jre><opt>` section.
The .vmoptions file will be fully functional when a newer version of Launch4j is installed.

# SoapUI ${project.version} Installer Script # Created automatically by build system
!include "MUI2.nsh" !include "FileFunc.nsh" !include "nsDialogs.nsh"
# Product identification !define PRODUCT_NAME "SoapUI" !define PRODUCT_VERSION "${project.version}"
# Installer configuration Name "SoapUI ${project.version}" OutFile "${installer.output}" InstallDir "$LOCALAPPDATA\SmartBear\SoapUI-${project.version}" InstallDirRegKey HKCU "Software\SmartBear\SoapUI-${project.version}" "InstallPath" RequestExecutionLevel highest SetCompressor /SOLID lzma
# Variables for installation scope Var StartMenuFolder Var InstallScope Var StartMenuPath Var ProductUninstallKey
# Variables for the installation scope page Var Dialog Var Label1 Var RadioCurrentUser Var RadioAllUsers Var LabelNote
# Generate hash format: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-X Function GenerateHash Push $R0 Push $R1 Push $R2 Push $R3 Push $R4 Push $R5 Push $R6
# Base calculation using product name and version StrCpy $R0 "${PRODUCT_NAME}${PRODUCT_VERSION}" StrLen $R1 $R0
# Generate 5 hash components using different algorithms
# Component 1: Based on product name length and version IntOp $R1 $R1 * 17 IntOp $R1 $R1 + 5000 IntOp $R1 $R1 % 10000 IntFmt $R2 "%04d" $R1
# Component 2: Based on version number extraction StrCpy $R3 "${PRODUCT_VERSION}" StrCpy $R3 $R3 1 0 # First character of version IntOp $R3 $R3 + 2500 IntOp $R3 $R3 * 31 IntOp $R3 $R3 % 10000 IntFmt $R3 "%04d" $R3
# Component 3: Based on product name hash StrCpy $R4 "${PRODUCT_NAME}" StrLen $R4 $R4 IntOp $R4 $R4 * 73 IntOp $R4 $R4 + 400 IntOp $R4 $R4 % 10000 IntFmt $R4 "%04d" $R4
# Component 4: Combined hash IntOp $R5 $R1 + $R3 IntOp $R5 $R5 * 13 IntOp $R5 $R5 + 4000 IntOp $R5 $R5 % 10000 IntFmt $R5 "%04d" $R5
# Component 5: Single digit based on all previous IntOp $R6 $R1 + $R3 IntOp $R6 $R6 + $R4 IntOp $R6 $R6 + $R5 IntOp $R6 $R6 % 10 IntFmt $R6 "%01d" $R6
# Create hash: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-X StrCpy $ProductUninstallKey "$R2-$R3-$R4-$R5-$R6"
Pop $R6 Pop $R5 Pop $R4 Pop $R3 Pop $R2 Pop $R1 Pop $R0 FunctionEnd

# Helper function to check uninstall entries for SoapUI (VERSION SPECIFIC) Function CheckUninstallEntries Push $R0 # Registry key base Push $R1 # Counter Push $R2 # Key name Push $R3 # Display name Push $R4 # Publisher Push $R5 # Uninstall string Push $R6 # Result (found/not found) Push $R7 # Display version
# Get parameters: $R0 = registry root ("HKCU" or "HKLM") Exch $R0
StrCpy $R1 0 # Counter StrCpy $R6 "" # Result - empty means not found
enum_loop: # Enumerate uninstall entries StrCmp $R0 "HKCU" 0 enum_hklm EnumRegKey $R2 HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall" $R1 Goto check_key
enum_hklm: EnumRegKey $R2 HKLM "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall" $R1
check_key: # If no more keys, exit StrCmp $R2 "" enum_done
# Read display name from this uninstall entry StrCmp $R0 "HKCU" 0 read_hklm_display ReadRegStr $R3 HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "DisplayName" ReadRegStr $R4 HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "Publisher" ReadRegStr $R5 HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "UninstallString" Goto check_display_name
read_hklm_display: ReadRegStr $R3 HKLM "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "DisplayName" ReadRegStr $R4 HKLM "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "Publisher" ReadRegStr $R5 HKLM "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "UninstallString"
check_display_name: # Check if this is a SoapUI installation with the EXACT VERSION # Look for "SoapUI" in display name or "SmartBear" as publisher, but also check version
# Check if display name contains "SoapUI" (case insensitive) Push $R3 # Original display name Push "SoapUI" Call StrStr Pop $R3 # Result of search (found string or empty) StrCmp $R3 "" check_publisher_direct
# Found SoapUI in display name - now check version # Read the actual DisplayVersion value StrCmp $R0 "HKCU" 0 read_hklm_version ReadRegStr $R3 HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "DisplayName" ReadRegStr $R7 HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "DisplayVersion" Goto check_version_match
read_hklm_version: ReadRegStr $R3 HKLM "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "DisplayName" ReadRegStr $R7 HKLM "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "DisplayVersion"
check_version_match: # Check if the version matches exactly StrCmp $R7 "${project.version}" found_soapui_display next_key
found_soapui_display: StrCpy $R6 "DisplayName:$R3|Publisher:$R4|Uninstall:$R5|Key:$R2|Version:$R7" Goto enum_done
check_publisher_direct: # Check if publisher is SmartBear Push $R4 # Original publisher name Push "SmartBear" Call StrStr Pop $R4 # Result of search StrCmp $R4 "" next_key
# Found SmartBear as publisher - restore original display name and check if SoapUI related ReadRegStr $R3 HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "DisplayName" ReadRegStr $R4 HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "Publisher" StrCmp $R0 "HKCU" 0 +3 Goto check_soapui_in_smartbear ReadRegStr $R3 HKLM "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "DisplayName" ReadRegStr $R4 HKLM "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "Publisher"
check_soapui_in_smartbear: Push $R3 # Display name Push "SoapUI" Call StrStr Pop $R3 # Result StrCmp $R3 "" next_key
# Found SmartBear SoapUI - now check version # Read the actual DisplayVersion value StrCmp $R0 "HKCU" 0 read_hklm_version_smartbear ReadRegStr $R3 HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "DisplayName" ReadRegStr $R7 HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "DisplayVersion" Goto check_version_match_smartbear
read_hklm_version_smartbear: ReadRegStr $R3 HKLM "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "DisplayName" ReadRegStr $R7 HKLM "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R2" "DisplayVersion"
check_version_match_smartbear: # Check if the version matches exactly StrCmp $R7 "${project.version}" found_smartbear_soapui next_key
found_smartbear_soapui: StrCpy $R6 "DisplayName:$R3|Publisher:$R4|Uninstall:$R5|Key:$R2|Version:$R7" Goto enum_done
next_key: IntOp $R1 $R1 + 1 Goto enum_loop
enum_done: # Return result in $R6 Pop $R7 Pop $R5 Pop $R4 Pop $R3 Pop $R2 Pop $R1 Exch $R6 # Put result on stack Exch 1 Pop $R0 # Remove input parameter FunctionEnd
# Case-insensitive string search function Function StrStr Exch $R1 # $R1=substring, stack=[old$R1,string,...] Exch # stack=[string,old$R1,...] Exch $R2 # $R2=string, stack=[old$R2,old$R1,...] Push $R3 Push $R4 Push $R5 StrLen $R3 $R1 StrCpy $R4 0 ; $R1=substring, $R2=string, $R3=strlen(substring) ; $R4=count loop: StrCpy $R5 $R2 $R3 $R4 StrCmp $R5 $R1 done StrCmp $R5 "" done IntOp $R4 $R4 + 1 Goto loop done: StrCmp $R5 $R1 found StrCpy $R1 "" Goto end found: StrCpy $R1 $R5 end: Pop $R5 Pop $R4 Pop $R3 Pop $R2 Exch $R1 FunctionEnd
# Enhanced function to check for existing SoapUI installations Function CheckExistingInstallations Push $R0 # Result from user check Push $R1 # Result from machine check Push $R2 # Installation type Push $R3 # Parsed info Push $R4 # Temporary for version string
# Force 64-bit registry access to prevent WOW6432Node redirection SetRegView 64
# Print localized detection header DetailPrint $(DETECTION_HEADER)
# Print scanning message with version StrCpy $R4 "${project.version}" DetailPrint "$(DETECTION_SCANNING)" DetailPrint "$(DETECTION_TARGET)"
# Check user-level installations first DetailPrint $(DETECTION_USER_CHECK) Push "HKCU" Call CheckUninstallEntries Pop $R0
# Check machine-level installations DetailPrint $(DETECTION_MACHINE_CHECK) Push "HKLM" Call CheckUninstallEntries Pop $R1
# Analyze results - Check both HKCU and HKLM results StrCmp $R0 "" check_machine_only StrCmp $R1 "" user_only_found
# Both found - prioritize machine-level (All Users) as it's more comprehensive DetailPrint $(DETECTION_BOTH_FOUND) StrCpy $R4 $R1 DetailPrint "$(DETECTION_MACHINE_DETAILS)" StrCpy $R4 $R0 DetailPrint "$(DETECTION_USER_DETAILS)" StrCpy $R2 $(SCOPE_ALL_USERS_PRIORITY) StrCpy $R3 $R1 Goto found_installation
user_only_found: # Found only user installation DetailPrint $(DETECTION_USER_FOUND) StrCpy $R4 $R0 DetailPrint "$(DETAILS_LABEL) $R4" StrCpy $R2 $(SCOPE_CURRENT_USER_ONLY) StrCpy $R3 $R0 Goto found_installation
check_machine_only: StrCmp $R1 "" no_installation # Found only machine installation DetailPrint $(DETECTION_MACHINE_FOUND) StrCpy $R4 $R1 DetailPrint "$(DETAILS_LABEL) $R4" StrCpy $R2 $(SCOPE_ALL_USERS_ONLY) StrCpy $R3 $R1
found_installation: DetailPrint $(DETECTION_EXISTING_HEADER) StrCpy $R4 $R2 DetailPrint "$(DETECTION_SCOPE)" StrCpy $R4 $R3 DetailPrint "$(DETECTION_DETAILS)" DetailPrint $(DETECTION_SEPARATOR)
# Show user-friendly message MessageBox MB_OKCANCEL|MB_ICONEXCLAMATION \ "$(MSG_INSTALLATION_DETECTED)" \ IDOK continue_installation
# User chose to cancel DetailPrint $(DETECTION_CANCELLED) Abort
continue_installation: DetailPrint $(DETECTION_CONTINUE) Goto cleanup
no_installation: DetailPrint $(DETECTION_NONE_HEADER) StrCpy $R4 "${project.version}" DetailPrint "$(DETECTION_NONE_MSG)" DetailPrint $(DETECTION_SAFE) DetailPrint $(DETECTION_NOTE_OTHER) DetailPrint $(DETECTION_SEPARATOR)
cleanup: # Restore registry view SetRegView lastused
Pop $R4 Pop $R3 Pop $R2 Pop $R1 Pop $R0 FunctionEnd

admin_user: # Admin - enable both options and pre-select all users (recommended for admins) ${NSD_SetState} $RadioAllUsers ${BST_CHECKED} ${NSD_CreateLabel} 25u 100u 100% 15u $(SCOPE_NOTE_ADMIN) Pop $LabelNote
show_dialog: nsDialogs::Show FunctionEnd
# Function called when current user radio is clicked Function CurrentUserRadioClick Pop $R0 ${NSD_GetState} $R0 $R1 IntCmp $R1 1 0 +3 +3 ${NSD_SetState} $RadioAllUsers ${BST_UNCHECKED} FunctionEnd
# Function called when all users radio is clicked Function AllUsersRadioClick Pop $R0 ${NSD_GetState} $R0 $R1 IntCmp $R1 1 0 +3 +3 ${NSD_SetState} $RadioCurrentUser ${BST_UNCHECKED} FunctionEnd
# Function called when leaving the installation scope page Function InstallScopePageLeave # Check which option was selected ${NSD_GetState} $RadioAllUsers $R0 DetailPrint "Radio All Users state: $R0" IntCmp $R0 1 all_users_selected current_user_selected current_user_selected
all_users_selected: # Set variables for all users installation DetailPrint "Setting scope to AllUsers" StrCpy $InstallScope "AllUsers" StrCpy $StartMenuPath "$SMPROGRAMS" StrCpy $INSTDIR "$PROGRAMFILES64\SmartBear\SoapUI-${project.version}" Goto scope_done
current_user_selected: # Set variables for current user installation (already set in .onInit, but ensure) DetailPrint "Setting scope to CurrentUser" StrCpy $InstallScope "CurrentUser" StrCpy $StartMenuPath "$SMPROGRAMS" StrCpy $INSTDIR "$LOCALAPPDATA\SmartBear\SoapUI-${project.version}"
scope_done: DetailPrint "Final InstallScope: $InstallScope" FunctionEnd
# Function to show installation files page with details expanded Function InstallFilesShow # Show details by default SendMessage $mui.InstFilesPage.Log ${WM_VSCROLL} ${SB_BOTTOM} 0 # Expand details section GetDlgItem $0 $HWNDPARENT 1016 ShowWindow $0 ${SW_HIDE} GetDlgItem $0 $HWNDPARENT 1027 ShowWindow $0 ${SW_SHOW} FunctionEnd
# Uninstallation section with hash-based registry cleanup Section "Uninstall" # Force 64-bit registry access for uninstaller too SetRegView 64 # Remove main files RMDir /r "$INSTDIR\bin" RMDir /r "$INSTDIR\lib" RMDir /r "$INSTDIR\jre" RMDir /r "$INSTDIR\licenses" # Note: .soapuios is in user home, not installation dir # RMDir /r "$INSTDIR\.soapuios"
# Remove optional components RMDir /r "$INSTDIR\HermesJMS" RMDir /r "$INSTDIR\Tutorials"
# Remove root files Delete "$INSTDIR\*.url" Delete "$INSTDIR\*.md" Delete "$INSTDIR\LICENSE.txt" Delete "$INSTDIR\RELEASENOTES.txt" Delete "$INSTDIR\uninstall.exe"
# Remove main directory (if empty) RMDir "$INSTDIR"
# Determine uninstall scope and remove hash-based registry entries ReadRegStr $R0 HKLM "Software\SmartBear\SoapUI-${project.version}" "UninstallKey" StrCmp $R0 "" check_user_install
# Machine-level installation with hash DeleteRegKey HKLM "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R0" DeleteRegKey HKLM "Software\SmartBear\SoapUI-${project.version}"
# Try to remove SmartBear key if empty (ignore errors if not empty or other versions exist) DeleteRegKey /ifempty HKLM "Software\SmartBear"
StrCpy $StartMenuPath "$SMPROGRAMS" Goto check_legacy_cleanup
check_user_install: ReadRegStr $R0 HKCU "Software\SmartBear\SoapUI-${project.version}" "UninstallKey" StrCmp $R0 "" check_legacy_cleanup
# User-level installation with hash DeleteRegKey HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\$R0" DeleteRegKey HKCU "Software\SmartBear\SoapUI-${project.version}"
# Try to remove SmartBear key if empty (ignore errors if not empty or other versions exist) DeleteRegKey /ifempty HKCU "Software\SmartBear"
StrCpy $StartMenuPath "$SMPROGRAMS"
check_legacy_cleanup: # Clean up legacy installations (old format without hash) if they exist DeleteRegKey HKLM "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\SoapUI" DeleteRegKey HKCU "Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\SoapUI"
# Remove file associations DeleteRegKey HKCR ".soapui-project" DeleteRegKey HKCR "SoapUI.Project"
# Remove all Start Menu shortcuts (dynamic location) !insertmacro MUI_STARTMENU_GETFOLDER Application $StartMenuFolder Delete "$StartMenuPath\$StartMenuFolder\SoapUI-${project.version}.lnk" Delete "$StartMenuPath\$StartMenuFolder\Install HermesJMS.lnk" Delete "$StartMenuPath\$StartMenuFolder\SoapUI Tutorials.lnk" Delete "$StartMenuPath\$StartMenuFolder\SoapUI ${project.version} Uninstaller.lnk" Delete "$StartMenuPath\$StartMenuFolder\soapui.org website.url" Delete "$StartMenuPath\$StartMenuFolder\Online JavaDoc.url" RMDir "$StartMenuPath\$StartMenuFolder"
# Remove desktop shortcut Delete "$DESKTOP\SoapUI ${project.version}.lnk" SectionEnd
